rules.content:
/*
NightSky ransomware (Rook/LockFile-related)
*/

rule NightSky_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.nightsky"
        description = "Detects NightSky ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "NightSkyReadMe.hta" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "NightSky" ascii nocase
        $s3 = ".nightsky" ascii

    condition:
        any of them
}
